About Essential Energy

Essential Energy is the electricity distribution network for parts of NSW, QLD — it owns and maintains the poles, wires and substations that carry power to roughly 3,738 suburbs we track. It is not an energy retailer: which distributor serves you is decided by your address, not by the company that bills you.

We collect Essential Energy's publicly published outage information continuously and show it alongside the other connected networks, so you do not have to know whose network you are on before you can find out whether your power is out. Essential Energy remains the authority on its own network.

No electricity?

Check our outage map to see if we are aware of the outage or if it is part of a planned interruption. You can also give us a call on 13 10 93.

If other appliances in your home are working or it looks like your neighbours have power there may be a problem inside your home. You may need to check your trip switches or fuses.

Is Your Power Out home.text:
Is Your Power Out
HOME
LIVE MAP
BLOG
ABOUT
GUIDES
Is Your Power Out

Plain-language guides for Australian households, plus a live map that aggregates public outage data from participating electricity networks.

TAKE ME TO THE LIVE MAP

Electricity keeps modern life humming: refrigeration, hot water, lighting, pumps, communications, and - for many people - medical or mobility-support equipment. When the grid falters, the same hour can feel boring (board games by torchlight) or frightening (heat, health, and uncertainty stacking together). This site exists in the middle: we publish thoughtful articles you can read any time, and we host a tracker that helps you see what participating distributors are publishing right now.

The tracker is deliberately map-first. You can search a town, zoom to your area, filter by state or network, and switch between planned maintenance and unplanned faults.
